_meta.logp_source: ChEMBL_37 (release 2026-05-01) computed molecular property ALogP (Ghose-Crippen-Viswanadhan atom-based octanol-water logP), read per molecule from the ChEMBL molecule.molecule_properties.alogp field. ChEMBL molecule id given per drug.
_meta.ionization_note: Ionization class is used only to choose the Austin 2002 lipophilicity term: logP for bases (basic pKa > 7.4), logD7.4 for neutral/acidic. Every drug here is a base or a neutral (no acids). ALogP is used as the logP/D input: for bases it is logP directly; for the neutral benzodiazepines logD7.4 equals logP because they carry no group ionized at pH 7.4 (amine pKa <= 4.6), so the correct Austin input is ALogP in both cases.
_meta.rb_note: Blood:plasma ratio Rb. A targeted literature search (2026-10-27) for measured human Rb across this CNS set returned almost nothing public: only clozapine has a clearly measured human Rb (~0.87). Rb for the rest is not publicly reported, so the base/neutral default Rb = 1.0 is applied (bases and neutrals partition roughly equally between erythrocytes and plasma water; no acid 0.55 case occurs here). clozapine's 0.87 is recorded but not applied, to keep one consistent convention rather than a single-drug exception; its effect (fu_b up ~15%, CL up ~15%) is within the arm's fold-error and does not change the train conclusion.

clozapine.rb_measured_note: measured human whole-blood:plasma ~0.87 (clozapine clinical PK); not applied, see _meta.rb_note
